status_summary: EPA's 2025-03-25 news release says the Administrator directed the Office of Water to fast-track review and approval of state primacy under the Safe Drinking Water Act. EPA has since published final rules approving Arizona's primacy for all six injection well classes (2025-09-15, effective 2025-10-15), Texas's Class VI primacy (2025-11-14, effective 2025-12-15) and Colorado's Class VI primacy (2026-10-13, effective 2026-11-12); West Virginia's Class VI approval was published 2025-02-26. EPA Region 5 also published a tentative approval of Illinois's drinking water PFAS rule primacy revision (2026-09-30), and EPA proposed to approve Utah's Class VI primacy (2026-10-22). No executive order on primacy, no Clean Water Act section 404 assumption approval, and no coordination step with the Army Corps or Interior under such an effort were found.

timeline.event: EPA published a final rule approving West Virginia's Class VI well primacy.
EPA's news release reported the Administrator had directed the Office of Water to fast-track review of state Safe Drinking Water Act primacy applications.
EPA published a final rule approving Arizona's primacy for all six injection well classes.
EPA published a final rule approving Texas's Class VI primacy.

EPA Region 5 published a notice of tentative approval of Illinois's Public Water System Supervision program revision to adopt the federal PFAS drinking water rule (91 FR 61847), to become final and effective 2026-10-30 absent a timely hearing request.
EPA published a final rule approving Colorado's Class VI primacy, effective 2026-11-12.
EPA published a proposed rule to approve Utah's Class VI primacy (91 FR 66662; comments due 2026-12-07; docket EPA-HQ-OW-2026-0496).

title: Expedite state primacy approvals under the Clean Water Act and Safe Drinking Water Act
uncertainties: The evidence is concentrated on underground injection well primacy under the Safe Drinking Water Act. A Federal Register docket item suggests the West Virginia approval may have been signed before 2025-01-20, so it may not reflect the directive. A Federal Register search on 2026-10-13 found no Clean Water Act section 404 assumption approvals; NPDES authorizations were not separately searched. A Federal Register listing indicates an EPA proposed rule on Alaska Class VI primacy (FR Doc. 2026-22085, 2026-10-29); the document could not be opened on federalregister.gov in this review, so it is not used as a timeline event until its terms are read. The Illinois item concerns drinking water PFAS rule primacy and is a tentative approval; the Utah and Alaska items are proposals, not approvals. Whether a hearing request was filed on the Illinois tentative approval by 2026-10-30 was not verified.
